focus: Map the live PutImage/Composite function pointers from DamageTraceV2 back to the unstripped local libXlorie.so, then instrument or optimize that exact implementation.

phase_reviews.notes: XlorieIdentity logs prove the host process uses com.runelitetablet base.apk libXlorie.so and the app-process server uses the extracted copy under /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/tmp/termux-x11-com.runelitetablet-libs.
DamageTraceV2 is live in validated internal-hybrid runs and shows PutImage backend=other plus Composite function pointers from the extracted server library.

decisions: The correct package to rebuild for hybrid runtime diagnostics is runelite-tablet :app, not only third_party/termux-x11-upstream :app.
Present/AHB work remains gated because the validated workload still never enters the Present path.
The real hot path is PutImage on WINDOW with backend=other inside the extracted app-process libXlorie.so.
dladdr resolves the hot function pointers to the extracted server library but not to symbol names, so offset mapping is the next direct step.
fix_attempts: Added XlorieIdentity native entry-point logs to resolve the active library path.
Corrected the build/install loop to target runelite-tablet :app.
Extended DamageTraceV2 to include backend, function pointer, and library identity.

blocked.reason: Speculative Present/AHB implementation is not justified until the exact hot PutImage implementation is mapped and understood.
